## Release integrity

- [ ] Artifacts were generated from canonical source and were not hand-edited.
- [ ] Version, source commit, generator command, checksums, and generation date are recorded.
- [ ] No credentials, private user data, debug files, caches, or local configuration are included.
- [ ] Publication credentials are isolated from untrusted validation and protected appropriately.
- [ ] Workflow changes use explicit least privilege and immutable Action references.
- [ ] Rollback/removal procedure is documented.
